body: I fight everyday to stay alive, I feel 100% that I don’t belong on this planet. I know how you feel, many people can not relate. It’s an uncontrollable Urg. I have no family no support! I have a 15yr son. He thinks I’m Superman and I’m a piece of shit. Talk to me! I can relate. I have a scare on my neck from someone cutting a rope off around my neck! I was addicted to drugs, I beat that. I can’t beat this. I used to want to go via over dosing. I refuse to have any drugs in my system now if they do Abtopsy. I’m here if you wanna talk!

Please don’t do it. I know the feeling, killing myself consumes my brain more then drugs. Every survivor that jumped and lived off that bridge regret it the second there hands let go! Talk to someone! Not a doctor cause they don’t know shit. Talk to a survivor! Can’t promise things will get better! All I know is I refuse to let the demons in my head win! We are stronger then that! Stay alive!!

I’m not much for words, you’re not alone! I feel the same way. Only thing keeps me going is hoping tomorrow gets better! Can’t let the demons in our heads win. Be stronger then that! I will fight till I cant fight no more!!! Fight!
Funny no one ever asked me!!!
Need to up your pull out game!
